subtopics.label: Cost-Effectiveness Analysis of Medical Interventions
subtopics.description: Research applying formal cost-effectiveness and cost-benefit frameworks to evaluate medical treatments, diagnostics, and interventions, including ICER calculations, microsimulation models, and return-on-investment analyses across diverse clinical areas.
subtopics.short_description: Formal cost-effectiveness and cost-benefit frameworks evaluating treatments, diagnostics, and interventions using ICER calculations and microsimulation models.

subtopics.label: Pharmaceutical Pricing, Biosimilars, and Drug Coverage Policy
subtopics.description: Research examining drug pricing dynamics, biosimilar market entry and uptake, formulary restrictions, Medicare Part B and D coverage policies, and the role of intermediaries such as pharmacy benefit managers and group purchasing organizations in shaping pharmaceutical spending.
subtopics.short_description: Pharmaceutical pricing dynamics, biosimilar market entry, formulary restrictions, and the role of PBMs in shaping drug spending.

subtopics.label: Economic Dimensions of Opioid Use Disorder and Overdose
subtopics.description: Research quantifying the economic burden of opioid use disorder and overdose deaths, evaluating cost-effectiveness of medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD), analyzing payment and coverage policies for OUD treatment, and assessing the economic impact of opioid prescribing regulations.
subtopics.short_description: Costs of opioid use disorder and overdose deaths, cost-effectiveness of MOUD, and economic impact of prescribing regulations.

subtopics.label: Private Equity, Market Consolidation, and Healthcare Prices
subtopics.description: Research investigating the effects of private equity acquisitions, physician management companies, and corporate consolidation on healthcare prices, utilization, quality, and spending across sectors including nursing homes, hospice, ophthalmology, dermatology, and anesthesia.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of private equity acquisitions and corporate consolidation on healthcare prices, utilization, and quality across clinical sectors.

subtopics.label: Value-Based Payment Programs and Physician Incentive Systems
subtopics.description: Research evaluating Medicare value-based payment programs including the Merit-Based Incentive Payment System (MIPS), Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs), the Medicare Shared Savings Program, and alternative payment models, focusing on performance measurement, financial incentives, and care quality outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Medicare value-based programs including MIPS, ACOs, and the Shared Savings Program, focusing on financial incentives and care quality.

subtopics.label: Medicaid Expansion, Insurance Coverage, and Access to Care
subtopics.description: Research examining the effects of Medicaid expansion under the Affordable Care Act on insurance coverage, access to care, treatment utilization, and health outcomes across populations including cancer patients, liver disease, foster youth, and low-income adults.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of ACA Medicaid expansion on coverage, care access, treatment utilization, and outcomes among low-income and vulnerable populations.

subtopics.label: Healthcare Spending, Utilization, and Waste Reduction
subtopics.description: Research analyzing patterns of healthcare spending and utilization including potentially preventable spending, geographic variation in Medicare costs, high-cost patient populations, low-value services, and interventions to reduce unnecessary healthcare resource use.
subtopics.short_description: Geographic variation in Medicare costs, high-cost patient populations, low-value services, and interventions to reduce unnecessary resource use.

subtopics.label: Telehealth Expansion, Utilization, and Economic Impact
subtopics.description: Research evaluating the adoption, utilization patterns, cost implications, and quality outcomes of telehealth and telemedicine services, including policy changes during and after COVID-19, variation by provider and patient characteristics, and impacts on downstream care use.
subtopics.short_description: Cost implications, utilization patterns, and quality outcomes of telehealth services, including policy changes following COVID-19.

subtopics.label: Nursing Home and Long-Term Care Economics and Quality
subtopics.description: Research examining financial structures, ownership models, staffing levels, and quality outcomes in nursing homes and long-term care settings, including the roles of private equity, real estate investment trusts, and skilled nursing facility payment policies.
subtopics.short_description: Financial structures, ownership models, staffing, and quality outcomes in nursing homes, including private equity and REIT involvement.

subtopics.label: Economic Burden of Disease and Mortality
subtopics.description: Research quantifying the societal and economic costs of specific diseases, conditions, and mortality events including opioid overdose, maternal mortality, COVID-19 deaths, infectious diseases, and chronic conditions, using human capital and productivity loss frameworks.
subtopics.short_description: Quantifying economic costs of diseases, overdose deaths, and chronic conditions using human capital and productivity loss frameworks.

subtopics.label: Surgical Procedure Costs, Reimbursement, and Value
subtopics.description: Research analyzing the costs, reimbursement trends, and value of surgical and procedural interventions using time-driven activity-based costing, claims data, and cost-minimization approaches across specialties including urology, orthopedics, cardiac surgery, and general surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Costs and reimbursement trends for surgical interventions using activity-based costing and claims data across multiple specialties.

subtopics.label: Hepatitis C, HIV, and Infectious Disease Treatment Economics
subtopics.description: Research evaluating the cost-effectiveness, financing, and policy barriers to treatment for hepatitis C virus, HIV, and other infectious diseases, including Medicaid coverage restrictions, rapid treatment initiation programs, and economic modeling of elimination strategies.
subtopics.display_name: Hepatitis C, HIV & Infectious Disease Economics
subtopics.short_description: Cost-effectiveness, financing, and policy barriers to treatment for HCV, HIV, and other infectious diseases including Medicaid restrictions.

subtopics.label: Racial, Ethnic, and Socioeconomic Disparities in Healthcare Access and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research documenting and analyzing disparities in healthcare access, treatment utilization, and outcomes by race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status, including the role of insurance type, neighborhood conditions, and social determinants of health in driving inequitable care.
subtopics.short_description: Disparities in access, treatment utilization, and outcomes by race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status driven by insurance and social determinants.

subtopics.label: Payment Model Innovation and Healthcare Financing Reform
subtopics.description: Research examining novel payment and financing models for healthcare delivery including bundled payments, capitation, surprise billing legislation, coordinated specialty care financing, and the economic implications of payment reform for providers and patients.
subtopics.short_description: Novel financing models including bundled payments, capitation, and surprise billing legislation and their implications for providers and patients.

subtopics.label: Epidemiological and Economic Modeling of Disease Burden and Interventions
subtopics.description: Research using mathematical and simulation modeling to project disease burden, evaluate the population-level impact of public health interventions, and estimate the economic value of vaccination, screening, and prevention programs for infectious and chronic diseases.
subtopics.short_description: Simulation models projecting disease burden and estimating economic value of vaccination, screening, and prevention programs.

subtopics.label: Mental Health and Addiction Integration into General Healthcare
subtopics.description: Research on integrating behavioral health, mental health, and addiction treatment into general medical care settings, including policy levers, care models, and outcomes for patients with serious mental illness or co-occurring disorders.
subtopics.short_description: Integrating mental health and addiction treatment into general medical settings, including care models for serious mental illness and co-occurring disorders.

subtopics.label: Cannabis Legalization Policy and Health Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining the effects of medical and recreational cannabis legalization on opioid use, chronic pain treatment, illegal drug markets, and patterns of cannabis consumption.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of medical and recreational cannabis legalization on opioid use, chronic pain treatment, and drug market patterns.

subtopics.label: Healthcare Workforce Burnout, Turnover, and Training
subtopics.description: Research on physician and healthcare worker turnover, burnout, financial stresses in training, and workforce retention challenges including home health aides and direct care workers.
subtopics.short_description: Physician and care worker burnout, financial stresses in training, and retention challenges across clinical and direct care roles.

subtopics.label: Elder Abuse, Mistreatment, and Financial Exploitation
subtopics.description: Studies on the identification, coding, prevention, and economic dimensions of elder abuse, mistreatment, and financial exploitation among older adults.
subtopics.short_description: Identification, prevention, and economic dimensions of elder abuse, mistreatment, and financial exploitation among older adults.

subtopics.label: Cardiogenic Shock Management, Mechanical Circulatory Support, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on utilization of mechanical circulatory support devices, hospital transfer patterns, advanced therapy centers, and outcomes in patients with cardiogenic shock and acute myocardial infarction.
subtopics.short_description: Utilization of mechanical circulatory support devices, hospital transfer patterns, and outcomes in cardiogenic shock and acute MI patients.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Impact on Health Systems, Workforce, and Vulnerable Populations
subtopics.description: Studies examining the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on healthcare delivery, ICU capacity, health disparities, child mental health, social safety net policies, and vulnerable populations including home care workers and refugees.
subtopics.display_name: COVID-19 Impact on Health Systems & Populations
subtopics.short_description: Effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on care delivery, ICU capacity, health disparities, and vulnerable populations including home care workers.

subtopics.label: Global Health Systems, Surgical Capacity, and Access in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research on healthcare capacity, surgical access, cost-effectiveness of interventions, and health system barriers in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa.
subtopics.display_name: Global Health Systems in Low-Income Countries
subtopics.short_description: Surgical access, cost-effectiveness, and health system barriers in low- and middle-income countries, particularly sub-Saharan Africa.

subtopics.label: Opioid Prescribing Regulation and Policy Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies on the effects of regulatory and institutional policies—including drug rescheduling, marketing restrictions, and emergency department MOUD initiation—on opioid prescribing patterns and treatment access.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of drug rescheduling, marketing restrictions, and ED-based MOUD initiation on opioid prescribing patterns and treatment access.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Reconstruction Access, Disparities, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on patterns, disparities, and outcomes in postmastectomy breast reconstruction, including the influence of race, surgeon gender, legislation, and institutional factors.
subtopics.short_description: Patterns and disparities in postmastectomy breast reconstruction by race, surgeon gender, legislation, and institutional factors.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular Testing, Procedure Value, and Appropriateness
subtopics.description: Studies examining the appropriateness, value, and disparities in cardiovascular diagnostic testing and procedures, including high- versus low-value testing by insurance type and executive screening programs.
subtopics.short_description: Appropriateness and value of cardiovascular diagnostic procedures, including high- versus low-value testing variation by insurance type.

subtopics.label: Hospice, Palliative Care, and End-of-Life Healthcare Utilization
subtopics.description: Research on healthcare utilization, mortality, and cost considerations for patients receiving hospice or palliative care, including those with dementia and heart failure at end of life.
subtopics.short_description: Utilization, mortality, and cost considerations for patients in hospice or palliative care, including those with dementia and heart failure.

subtopics.label: Geographic, Racial, and Socioeconomic Disparities in Healthcare Access and Utilization
subtopics.description: Studies documenting disparities in access to care, screening, and treatment by race, ethnicity, geography, and socioeconomic status across a range of conditions including cancer, cardiovascular disease, and chronic illness.
subtopics.short_description: Disparities in screening, care access, and treatment by geography, race, and socioeconomic status across cancer, cardiovascular, and chronic conditions.

subtopics.label: Neonatal, Pediatric Care Policy, and Child Health Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on policies and clinical practices affecting neonatal and pediatric health outcomes, including prenatal substance use policies, neonatal ICU resource use, pediatric tracheostomy timing, and child mental health.
subtopics.short_description: Policies and practices affecting neonatal and pediatric outcomes, including prenatal substance use policy, NICU resource use, and child mental health.

subtopics.label: Health Information Technology, Billing Automation, and Data Systems
subtopics.description: Studies on the use of electronic medical records, health information exchange, natural language processing, and data systems to improve clinical documentation, billing, and care quality.
subtopics.short_description: Electronic medical records, billing automation, and data systems supporting clinical documentation and care quality.

subtopics.label: Comorbidity, Chronic Disease Burden, and Healthcare Resource Utilization
subtopics.description: Research examining how comorbidities and multimorbidity—including COPD, diabetes, sickle cell disease, and mental illness—drive healthcare utilization, hospitalizations, and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: How multimorbidity including COPD, diabetes, and sickle cell disease drives hospitalizations, resource use, and patient outcomes.
